Das xBoot summary

Dive deep into the treacherous waters of World War II with Nolimit City's marine release, a game that places you inside a high stakes combat submarine searching for lost gold. Operating on an unconventional 2-3-4-4-3-2 grid layout, this maritime adventure turns players into strategic commanders where naval forces clash under the sea. You can experience the claustrophobic tension of submarine warfare and play for free directly on our platform. The cinematic narrative follows a battle for underwater riches where u-boats face ferocious enemy depth charge attacks, proving that ocean hunters can easily become the prey.

Base Game Mechanics and Features

The core gameplay loop focuses on dynamic combinations that surface when custom modifiers align across the grid. Standard wins pay from left to right, but the layout changes rapidly thanks to several signature engines. The xWays symbol adds supplementary opportunities by expanding to reveal two or three matching symbols on a single position. The stacked xNudge Wilds occupy up to four vertical positions and automatically shift until they are fully visible, boosting the payout multiplier by one with every step. Furthermore, the xBomb Wild Multiplier acts as a wild substitute while detonating to clear away all non-winning items from the grid, creating an immediate cascade for new symbols to drop down while permanently increasing the win multiplier before the next collapse.

Bonus Rounds and Free Spins

Deploying your sonar and tracking down bonus symbols will lead you straight into the deepest features of the game. Catching three bonus symbols triggers eight Silent Hunter Spins, where the third reel expands significantly to reach eight rows high. Landing a winning combination with a Periscope Wild on this middle column initiates a torpedo launch sequence where hitting the target causes the wild to expand to the top, nudging down to award a win multiplier for every single step down. If you secure four bonus symbols instead, you will unlock eight Wolf Pack Spins where you load up the submarine torpedo bay. In this supreme tier, your crew must collect xWays Wild symbols and accumulate four separate torpedo parts to launch full strikes, increasing the global win multiplier with every deployment. These compounding configurations make the game a brilliant choice if you want to test your tactical precision in a free slot tournament to compete for real rewards.

Volatility Rating and Potential

Mirroring the dangerous nature of a naval combat zone, this release operates with an official Extreme volatility rating. Captains who manage to navigate the heavy artillery can unlock the peak potential named Das Gold Des Roter Teufel, which caps out at a staggering 55,200x times the base bet. Navigating this punishing mathematical engine requires great patience as the high variance leads to dramatic shifts between spins. Practicing your underwater strategies using Playin coins on our site provides an ideal opportunity to understand the behavior of the expanded columns and coordinate your torpedo launches entirely risk free before competing against other players on the leaderboard.

Game xMechanics

xWays®

xWays® unlocks unprecedented win potential for players. Usually seen in a fixed Ways game, any xWays symbols that land reveals a stack of the same symbol, increasing the ways available to win, and when working alongside some of the other mechanics available in this series, such as xNudge or xSplit, can pave the way for some huge wins. xWays® first made an appearance in Pixies Vs Pirates, although many players will more likely recognise this mechanic from Punk Rocker, an early 2020 release. Alongside these two releases, xWays has made an appearance in a host of other NolimitCity games, including Dragon Tribe, East Coast vs West Coast, and San Quentin – the early 2021 release which rocked the community with news of a 150,000x maximum win availability.

xSplit®

xSplit® was first made available within xWays Hoarder xSplit, released in July 2021. On this first occasion, xSplit symbols go a long way towards assisting wins through the feature, as any xSplit symbols in view to the right of a Scatter symbol will turn the Scatter into a Super Scatter symbol – which within this release assists in progressing the feature through several levels. However, aside from the progression through bonus levels, xSplit as individual symbols increase win ways during base play. Any xSplit symbol in view will split all symbols to the left of it into two, increasing the ways to win. After this, the xSplit symbols will turn into wilds – for the potential of huge wins.

xNudge®

xNudge®: A simple yet effective feature that turns any game into a massive potential bearing title! xNudge works alongside wild reels, wherein landing a wild in view has the potential to increase the multiplier attached, as the wild nudges to fill the entire reel. If the wild is not centred in the reel, it will either nudge up or down, incrementing its multiplier by 1 for each nudge.
